dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sylvana is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Initially in care, Sylvana was been observed to be fearful. Noted to have a low body, whale eye, and will snap when the handler attempts to clip their leash. Recently Sylvanna has been observed to be kennel reactive. Noted to push off the wall and will fixate on the other dogs while growling and pulling towards them. With select handlers, Sylvana is social, receptive to treats, and will allow petting. Medically, Sylvana has dermatitis and otitis externa.

Sylvana arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Sylvana has been observed to be fearful. Given time with familiar handlers, she does relax and interact more with her environment while remaining aloof with her handler. Due to the detailed behavior, she would thrive best in a low-traffic, adult only home where she may decompress.
dog.name: Sylvana
